title: Conch Bangles of Old Dhaka
description:
Behind every pair of conch bangles lies a story of craftsmanship, tradition, and the hands that keep an age-old practice alive.

Shakhar Satkahon is a documentary exploring the lives and everyday realities of the artisans and workers of Shankhari Bazar, one of the oldest traditional neighbourhoods of Old Dhaka. Through their stories and the process of making conch bangles (shakha), the documentary offers a glimpse into a craft deeply rooted in the cultural heritage of Bangladesh.

Beyond the finished product, this documentary brings attention to the people behind the craft—their work, experiences, and the lives shaped by this longstanding tradition.
